# `aitbc market ratings`

View ratings for a market service offer.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market ratings [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service-id` | text | — | yes | The Service id. |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Number of ratings to return |
| `--offset` | integer | `0` | no | Offset for pagination |
| `--market-url` | text | — | no | Override the market service URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market ratings --service-id <service_id>
```
